function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

**Pet‑Friendly Train Stations in Miami** | Station | Address | Contact | Pet Policy (Amtrak) | |---------|---------|---------|---------------------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (Amtrak)** | 1 SE 1st St, Miami, FL 33131 | Phone: (305) 284‑4000
Website: [amtrak.com](https://www.amtrak.com) | • Small pets (dogs, cats, birds, etc.) are allowed in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• Pets must be leashed or in a carrier at all times.
• No pets are allowed in the station’s public areas (waiting rooms, restrooms, etc.).
• A small fee may apply for pets traveling in the car.
• Check Amtrak’s “Pet Travel” page for the latest rules and fees. | ### Why this station is the only one in Miami - **Amtrak’s sole passenger rail service in the city**: The Miami Intermodal Center is the only Amtrak station in Miami, serving the Silver Meteor, Silver Star, and Palmetto lines. - **Modern, fully accessible**: The station is a state‑of‑the‑art facility with elevators, ramps, and clear signage, making it easy to navigate with a pet. - **Convenient location**: It sits right next to the Miami International Airport and the Miami Central Station (for local transit), so you can easily transfer between air, rail, and bus services. ### Tips for traveling with pets from this station 1. **Book early**: Reserve your pet’s carrier space when you book your ticket. 2. **Check the carrier size**: Amtrak requires carriers to fit under the seat or in the luggage area; check the dimensions on their website. 3. **Bring water and a small bowl**: While pets aren’t allowed in the station, you can keep them hydrated in the car. 4. **Plan for breaks**: If you’re on a long trip, schedule stops at pet‑friendly rest areas or pet cafés along the route. 5. **Stay updated**: Amtrak occasionally updates pet policies, especially around holidays or special events. ### Nearby pet‑friendly amenities - **Pet cafés & dog parks**: The area around the Intermodal Center has several pet cafés (e.g., “Paws & Claws”) and nearby dog parks such as the **Miami Dog Park** (1.5 mi away). - **Pet supplies**: The **PetSmart** at 1 SE 1st St (inside the Intermodal Center) offers a quick stop for treats, leashes, or a quick grooming session. --- **Quick Summary** - **Station**: Miami Intermodal Center (Amtrak) - **Location**: 1 SE 1st St, Miami, FL 33131 - **Pet Policy**: Small pets allowed in carriers; no pets in public areas; check Amtrak’s website for fees and details. If you need more detailed information about pet travel regulations or want to confirm a specific pet’s eligibility, feel free to let me know!
